patch.value: Resume native agents from bounded incremental mutation cursors
Pull-based native transport for canonical mutation events; read-only local history adapter and versioned adapter capability.

Concurrent appends resume after the last admitted event exactly once; Stale cursors and unsupported adapters return typed refusals with remedies; Cancellation and backpressure remain bounded without Node or Git; Typed SDK, compact TOON and JSON CLI, documentation, seeded property and interleaving tests, public tracker validation, npm and Bun CI gates

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked against the pinned public SDK mutation-events declarations, native_adapter and read_session, and pm-context since.ts. Core listMutationEvents and subscribeMutationEventBatches own the compact event projection; pm-context owns delta ranking. This work adds native pull transport using that projection, with per-stream immutable prefix cursors so backdated concurrent appends remain visible. No import/export/sync, item writes, status interpretation, ranking, shared checkpoints or new event schema. Reuse existing native adapter admission and canonical history hashing/codecs; preserve backend refusals. Registry current CLI is 2026.10.27; retain the pinned 2026.10.21 oracle.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented ChangeReader and LocalChangeAdapter, additive changes ABI capability and one-page changes CLI. Native prefix cursors are caller-owned and immutable; independent readers do not share checkpoint state. The local path performs no item mutation, import/export/sync, status decision, lease or retry. Targeted SDK tests pass 7/7, including a fixed-seed 500-sequence model with older-input replay, CRLF and relationship-patch preservation read back through Workspace.history. No normalization oracle is duplicated. Continuing strict output fuzzing, step-boundary interleavings, revert proof, read-only public-data validation and CI coverage.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final overlap refresh: current CLI 2026.10.27 history events exposes resumable NDJSON, verify and provenance; pm-web resume-packets/history-read-gate consume core listMutationEvents; pm-context since owns ranked deltas. The native surface deliberately reuses the compact event fields and existing ABI, with no new ranking, write/sync path or backend. The local adapter uses physical stream prefixes rather than timestamp ordering so late appends cannot disappear. Scope: integer-only admission decisions; no status-role or relationship interpretation and no ambient create/update defaults. Public-copy validation: 86 items, 178 source files, 4519252 bytes, 2266 canonical events, 114 pages, 17141 max page bytes, 13994 max cursor bytes, 0 idle events, SDK equality and unchanged read-only copy; no Node/Git on native path. Final module coverage: 364 lines, 33 functions, 549 regions and 82 branches, all 100 percent. Four behavioral reverts fail in a disposable copy; fixed tests pass again. First pm-linked run hit its default 120-second compile timeout under shared-host load; retrying serially with a 900-second bound. Full npm/Bun gate evidence will come from CI.

value.text: Final self-review found a transport-correlation gap in the new SDK: a constant request ID cannot distinguish a delayed older page after multiple successful pulls. Binding correlation to the full cursor-bearing request and adding a genuine local-adapter delayed-reply regression. This stays within the exactly-once/stale-adapter acceptance criteria; no upstream SDK defect is involved. Reclaimed only this item for the correction; a fresh exact-head CI run will follow.

The page boundary also refuses duplicate physical identities across events and skip receipts. New focused regressions pass; refreshing the six-case revert proof, linked tests, coverage and public-copy validation before the next head.
